subject: Roundtable on-demand access stipends — last-minute confirmation
messages:
From: Ava Rossi <ava@brightrounds.co>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Last-minute ask: on-demand access stipends for roundtable

Hi Laura,

Quick ask — we had a late wave of cancellations and about 75 registrants missed the live roundtable yesterday. Can Redwood provide 75 on-demand access stipends (codes that grant 7-day access to the recording and downloadable materials)? If possible, we'd like the redemption window to be open for two weeks.

We're willing to absorb a small fee, but if there's a promo code route that keeps it on us (BrightRounds), that would be ideal — otherwise any special partner discount is fine.

Attached: attendee_cancellations_list.csv

Thanks,
Ava Rossi
Director, Partnerships
BrightRounds Events
ava@brightrounds.co

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Last-minute ask: on-demand access stipends for roundtable

Team — forwarding BrightRounds' request. They want 75 one-time codes that grant 7-day access to on-demand recording; redemption window 2 weeks. They offer to pay; want us to confirm cost / account credit path. Can we approve a partner stipend here? What's the quickest way to generate and track codes? See their attendee list attached.

Key questions:
- Approve total count and who absorbs cost?
- TTL/expiry and per-code access limits
- Which product route: promo code (partner-funded) or account credit (host funded)?

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: attendee_cancellations_list.csv (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Last-minute ask: on-demand access stipends for roundtable

Laura — precedent: we granted 50 partner-funded codes for the Spring Demo (March) with two-week windows. Finance tracked as marketing partner spend. If BrightRounds covers cost, we can treat as promo code issuance with zero discount on our ledger (partner pays external invoice). If we fund it, route through marketing budget (we capped at $1k for that event).

I'll attach a quick estimate for 75 one-week tokens (I modeled 7-day access + storage) — see budget-estimate-Q2.xlsx.

My recommendation: let partner pay (simpler) and we create code batch limited to one redemption per code, expiry 2027-05-26 (two weeks). We'll also require a simple registration verification token to reduce abuse.

Marissa
Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: budget-estimate-Q2.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Last-minute ask: on-demand access stipends for roundtable

Agree with Marissa. Operational notes:
- We can generate 75 single-use promo codes with a 14-day TTL. Recommend adding a metadata tag (brightrounds_202705) so we can track redemptions in Console.
- Set per-code access to 'recording_view' + asset download. Limit to 1 device/session to avoid sharing.
- If partner funds, finance needs an invoice reference: BR-2027-0543. If Redwood funds, we should post to marketing line item 'partner_stipends_2027Q2'.

Sean: can billing generate the code batch and share a secure CSV to send to BrightRounds? Also want a simple reporting dashboard (redemptions by code) — CS can query logs.

Rishi
Head of Revenue
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Last-minute ask: on-demand access stipends for roundtable

We can do this today. Need final confirmation on:
- Count (75 confirmed?)
- Expiry date: 2027-05-26 (14 days) or 2027-05-19 (7 days)?
- Funding: partner invoice id or Redwood GL account

Once confirmed, I'll generate promo_codes_brightrounds_20270512.csv (single-use) and put it on a secure Drive link. I'll also enable Console tag 'brightrounds_202705' and share a short redemption report template.

Attachments: promotional-code-template.txt (stub)

Sean
Billing & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Rossi <ava@brightrounds.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Last-minute ask: on-demand access stipends for roundtable — confirmed

Hi Ava — thanks for the patience. We can issue 75 single-use on-demand access codes with a 14-day redemption window (expiry 2027-05-26). BrightRounds requested to cover fees; please send invoice reference BR-2027-0543 and we'll mark the batch accordingly.

Download link (secure): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/secure/promo_codes_brightrounds_20270512.csv
Redemption tracking dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/reports/redemptions?tag=brightrounds_202705

Attachments: stipend-codes.csv (stub), budget-estimate-Q2.xlsx (stub)

Notes: We'll restrict each code to one redemption and to 'recording_view' + materials download. If you want a shorter TTL, let us know.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
